resolved_or_reduced: OS NGD Building Access Location is a point feature for pedestrian or vehicle entry and exit rather than a building footprint or parcel boundary
The current Building Access Location scope is limited to selected key public buildings and is not universal across all buildings
Building Access Location was introduced in March 2025 and temporal snapshots before 27 March 2025 can contain inconsistencies
Building Access Location has no TOID and its accessedbuildingid can be null
A building may have more than one Primary Public access location so an arbitrary single entrance must not be selected
Access mode purpose obstruction and level are observed access attributes and do not themselves prove legal right of access current accessibility compliance or parcel frontage
HMLR publication processing checks zero-coordinate polygons zero-area polygons and duplicate coordinate points
HMLR cleans many self-intersections for the publication environment and removes polygons below 0.1 square metres
Publication filtering means the public National Polygon dataset can differ from HMLR production geometry and cannot reconstruct omitted micro-polygons
HMLR validation files are supplied to verify that data has downloaded correctly and do not certify title accuracy topology legal boundary or Title-UPRN match quality
Ofcom has not published a fixed-performance postcode file since July 2024 and considers performance analysis robust to local-authority level rather than postcode level
Fixed availability downloads therefore cannot be used to manufacture postcode router-performance values
BDUK July 2026 management information is a 16 July snapshot rounded to the nearest ten and includes initial-scope contracted premises only
BDUK July 2026 reports 838490 contracted and 287510 built contracted premises at contract level
Type C Call Off contracts can combine several counties and regions in one contract name so contract totals cannot be assigned to a single local authority postcode UPRN or parcel
Repository searches found no acquired Building Access package HMLR validation bundle Ofcom fixed-performance postcode replacement or owned canonical parcel geometry
Equivalent blocked binary and DNS retrieval attempts were not repeated
